mechanism: Pyrazinamide may increase cyclosporine levels through CYP3A4 inhibition and reduce cyclosporine's immunosuppressive efficacy through hepatic enzyme induction, while cyclosporine may increase pyrazinamide-induced hyperuricemia and nephrotoxicity.
action: Monitor cyclosporine levels closely, assess renal function and uric acid levels; consider alternative TB therapy (isoniazid/rifampicin regimens) if possible, or adjust cyclosporine dosing based on therapeutic drug monitoring.
